figurative_meaning_bn: খুব বেশি হলে; গণনায় যে সংখ্যা যে পরিমাণের ঊর্ধ্বে আর যা না
figurative_meaning_en: at most; the maximum number or amount beyond which there is nothing more
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজ শেষ করতে বড়জোর দু'দিন লাগবে।
example_sentences_in_english: This task will take at most two days to complete.
At most twenty people will come to the party.
note: Commonly used in everyday Bengali speech to indicate an upper limit.
